web_context.competitor_activity: Adidas is the primary near-term threat: CEO's turnaround plan ahead of schedule, Samba/Gazelle lifestyle footwear dominating the market, and Adidas has stronger World Cup positioning as the tournament approaches. On Running and Hoka are taking share in premium performance running. Under Armour is restructuring (cutting Steph Curry deal, saving $45-50M) but remains focused on gym/high school segments rather than Nike's broad consumer market — less of a direct threat. Nike still leads with 27% athletic footwear/apparel market share vs Adidas at 13%, but Adidas momentum is visibly accelerating.
